'''Gamma One''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Gamma One was the leader of [[Gamma Squad (Galactic Republic)|Gamma Squad]] and during the Clone Wars led the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] on a [[Mission to Cularin|mission]] to infiltrate a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The squad disabled the defenses surrounding the facility's command center but were unable to enter it because their explosives weren't powerful enough to destroy the center's [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]]. Instead [[Gamma Two]] and [[Gamma Five]] tried to slice into the doors, while Gamma One and the other [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] covered them.

Five minutes later, a large number of droids emerged from nearby corridors and attacked the commandos. However, Gamma One soon dealt with the threat they posed by destroying all the droids with a grenade. Two and Five then finally got the doors open, and Five used the installation's communications system to send out a coded signal that placed all the droids ever built in the facility under covert control. With their objective achieved, Gamma One ordered the other [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to return to their [[Transport/Legends|transport]], while he placed a timed explosive on the installation's [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. He then activated the timer and ran to the transport.
